strings.tl: Hm, a brawl? Hell, you fellas could at least pull your punches...
H-help me... The P-Purple Sword... Purple Sword Berserkers!
No mistakin' it... T-two years ago, just the same as back then...
Get your weapons out! Get ready to fight!!

誰もいねえ・・・{1a}ファトゥムとガイウスが
力を貸してくれれば心強いんだが、
奴等は今回も動くまい・・・{1a}いかん、俺も歳だな。

Ain't nobody left in town who can stand up to a Berserker... // Be a comfort if Fatum and Gaius lent a hand, but they won't budge this time neither... // Damn it, I'm gettin' old. Turnin' this faint-hearted...
M-Mister... careful... There were five, no, six of 'em...

strings.read: {0c:fe}

strings.tl: Six of 'em!? That makes it even more hopeless... So, who'd ya see? Where are they?
The one who came at me was a big fella from Sefita, name of Sadler. // And there was rookies too, I think. Seemed like about two of 'em...
Rookies too, huh... I'd like to at least kill 'em quick, but we ain't got that luxury...

あの剣から生えてる触手が
奴等の腕に絡みついてる。
剣だけ叩き落とすのは無理なんだ。{1a}もっとも、それが出来たとしても

strings.tl: Those tentacles growin' out of the swords are wrapped round their arms. Ain't no way to knock just the sword away. // Even if ya could, we ain't got the time to spare for it. // What you're facin' is a beast. Kill it or it kills you. Sorry, but give it up!
